Checkbox Custom Fields — Edit

Create a custom field with a checkbox for yes/no values.

Checkbox fields are useful for tracking boolean attributes like active/inactive status.

Name

Enter the name of this checkbox custom field. This label appears next to the checkbox.

Checkbox fields are perfect for yes/no questions, confirmations, or optional features.

Position

Enter a position number to control the display order. Lower numbers appear first.

Group related checkboxes together using consecutive position numbers.

Placement

Select where this checkbox should appear. You can assign it to multiple forms or line items.

Examples: 'Tax exempt' on customers, 'Requires approval' on purchases, 'Fragile' on inventory items.

Description

Enter help text that appears below the checkbox. This guides users on when to check this box.

Clearly explain what checking the box means, like 'Check if customer is tax exempt' or 'Check if item requires special handling'.

Exclude from copying or cloning

Check this box to prevent this checkbox value from being copied when duplicating records.

Use for checkboxes that should be reconsidered for each record, like approval status.

Locked for manual editing

Check this box to prevent this field's value from being edited by users.

This is typically used when custom field is updated by extension rather than users directly.

Show custom field on printed documents

Check this box to show the checkbox status on the View screen after saving.

Display important flags or statuses so users can see them without editing the record.

Show at the top of printed documents

If displayed on View, check this box to show the checkbox at the top of the View screen.

Place critical status indicators at the top, like 'Approved', 'On hold', or 'Urgent'.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this checkbox field. It won't appear on new forms but existing data is preserved.

The checkbox values in existing records remain unchanged and can be viewed in reports.
